grammar: Peel leading q/o/l while nonempty tail remains; nest in source order. One terminal prefix-shaped character is a distinct base variable. No role/meaning is supplied by the symbol names.
limits: This grammar covers arbitrary strings; coverage and literal roundtrip do not favor it.
Root identity and prefix segmentation are hypotheses, not confirmed morphology.
Single terminal l is a base variable distinct from the hypothesized prefix function L. This is a paid grammar convention, not a deciphered homograph.
No word boundary, glyph run, p/y prefix or alternate reader is normalized.
No default noun/Class and no semantic no-op assigned to unhandled text. All original occurrences and repetitions survive.
No operator function, clause attachment or later content consumer is established.
